sources.title: AI Models for Depressive Disorder Detection and Diagnosis: A Review
sources.snippet: Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) holds promise for developing objective, scalable, and timely diagnostic tools. In this paper, we present a comprehensive survey of state-of-the-art AI methods for depression detection and diagnosis, based on a systematic review of 55 key studies.
